title: The Raft Above the Falls
story: Three lantern-turtles have fallen asleep on a little reed raft, and the river is carrying them straight toward Thunderstep Falls — where Churnogg the Falls Gulper waits with his mouth open like a wet cave. Mr 6 leaps into a rowboat 1.5 leagues behind the raft. The raft drifts at 3.5 leagues per hour; Mr 6 rows at 8 leagues per hour.
question: How many minutes will it take Mr 6 to catch up to the raft?
solution: The raft keeps moving, so Mr 6 only gains 8 - 3.5 = 4.5 leagues of gap each hour.
Closing the 1.5-league gap takes 1.5 ÷ 4.5 = 1/3 of an hour.
One third of 60 minutes = 20 minutes to reach the sleepy turtles.
praise: Comparing the two speeds was exactly the right instinct — the missing step was subtracting them to see how fast the GAP shrinks.
hint: The raft isn't standing still. First work out how much of the gap Mr 6 erases in one single hour.
victory: Mr 6 scooped up all three snoring turtles with twenty minutes of clever arithmetic and one soggy cape. Churnogg got nothing but a mouthful of river and a very embarrassed burp.
imagePrompt: A brave numeral-six knight in a blue cape rowing hard down a misty green river toward a reed raft of sleeping lantern-turtles, with a huge grinning river-beast waiting in the spray at the waterfall's edge.
